Request reprint permissions here.For more than 25 years, Thailand’s conservative establishment and opposition forces have been locked in a struggle for the soul of the country. Royalists want palace institutions insulated from public criticism, a military licensed to intervene in times of political crisis, deferential political parties and politicians, and free rein to clamp down on political actors who fail to toe the line.
